# Nabi firmware and app support

This repository supports the Nabi ESP32 firmware and its local Android
companion app. Use the repository issue tracker for reproducible build,
connection, and runtime problems.

Before filing an issue, include the board target, firmware revision, ESP-IDF
version, steps to reproduce, and relevant redacted logs. Never post Wi-Fi
passwords, pairing codes, device keys, access tokens, or unredacted device
identifiers.

This repository does not provide an external cloud account or device-unbinding
service. See `LICENSE` and component notices for licensing and source credits.
